cohort: 1383 mothers and their newborns in 150 hospitals across eight countries in East Asia and the Pacific
finding: The study found a strong association between early essential newborn care (EENC) practices, particularly skin-to-skin contact (SSC) duration, and breastfeeding outcomes, with SSC of at least 90 minutes being significantly associated with both early breastfeeding initiation and exclusive breastfeeding.
mod_finding: While the study notes EBF was analyzed regarding delivery mode, no specific findings related to mode of delivery are reported in the abstract.
